L’auberge est extrêmement sale et insalubre. Il y a des cafards dans les chambres (dont un qui m'a couru dessus pendant la nuit), ainsi que des insectes et de la moisissure partout dans les salles de bain. La cuisine est également dans un état déplorable, avec de la nourriture en train de pourrir et des moucherons partout. 
En plus du manque total d’hygiène, la sécurité laisse également à désirer : des multiprises sont branchées les unes sur les autres, créant un risque électrique et un potentiel danger d’incendie.
Un établissement aussi sale que dangereux, où les conditions d’hébergement sont tout simplement inacceptables et surtout : pas de remboursement ou de geste commercial malgré tout ça. 
Une expérience vraiment décevante, je ne recommande absolument pas cet établissement.

reviews.title: Excellent budget choice
reviews.positive_text:
I loved the self check in, the free dinner, the quiet in the rooms, the privacy curtain over the dorm bed.  The staff /cleaners were all lovely and friendly.  
The price is the best and the reason I will keep coming back.  It's location so close to the station and the price. Perfect.
reviews.negative_text:
The room itself was sooo hot.  
I actually was sick for a few days after I checked out simply due to there being no ventilation in the room.  With several roommates mentioning they were sick already.   The aircon was off or broken and no windows were open.  It was so stuffy and definitely contributed or entirely was the reason I was ill after.

I've no way to know if the five dollars I rented for the plastic container for the fridge was reimbursed.  That part felt super dodgy. 

I had a few books I would have left if there was a space to put them.

My upper bunk needed a shelf to put things.  I had no shelf at all. I saw some beds did have them, so they need to be all double checked they're there.

The pillow was super uncomfy and made my neck sore.
Offering a second would have been great.  The norm in dorm rooms I've noticed is to generally "steal" an unoccupied beds pillow or swap for the better one.  Making them all good would stop this.
reviews.partner_reply: Thank you for your detailed feedback! We're delighted you enjoyed the self check-in, complimentary dinner, friendly staff, privacy curtains, and value for money. We sincerely apologise for the discomfort caused by the room temperature and ventilation, as well as the other concerns you raised. We appreciate your suggestions regarding bed shelves, pillows, and storage, and will share them with our team for review. Your feedback helps us improve, and we hope to have the opportunity to welcome you back for a more comfortable stay.

reviews.positive_text: Location
reviews.negative_text:
This place used to be good about five years ago, but unfortunately, the standard has deteriorated dramatically. It seems they have lowered their prices and opened the doors to just about anyone, and the overall environment has suffered as a result.

The place is now extremely dirty and messy, with some residents leaving filthy, smelly clothes scattered around their rooms. There are people struggling with drug and alcohol problems, disruptive behaviour, and a general lack of consideration for others. Many appear to be staying long-term rather than being ordinary travellers or holidaymakers.

The meals are incredibly basic and poor quality. Dinner is so cheap and unappealing that it feels more like a charity meal than something you'd expect from paid accommodation.

To be fair, the Sydney staff do try to do a good job, and I acknowledge their efforts. However, the management appears to have little control over the standard of residents or the behaviour occurring on the premises.

I've witnessed some extraordinary things, including someone running a power cord out of a window to charge an electric car parked in the driveway.

Customer service is another major problem. The overseas customer service team can sometimes be helpful, but too often, instead of taking responsibility and resolving a complaint, they look for excuses and try to shift the blame back onto the customer. Questions such as why an issue wasn't reported earlier seem to take priority over actually addressing the problem.

Management has apparently sent warnings about behaviour such as smoking drugs in rooms and urinating in bottles, yet the fact that such warnings are necessary tells you something about the environment.

It's disappointing because this place had a good reputation years ago. The Sydney staff deserve credit for trying, but the overall management, cleanliness, resident standards, food quality and customer service have deteriorated significantly.
reviews.partner_reply: Thank you for sharing such detailed feedback. We're very sorry to hear that your experience fell so far below the standard you remember from previous stays. The issues you describe, including cleanliness in shared areas, the behaviour of some long-term residents and the quality of our meals, do not reflect the environment we want for our guests. We also regret that your interactions with our customer service team felt more focused on process than on resolving your concerns. We sincerely apologize for this. Your comments have been shared with our management, housekeeping and front office teams so the concerns you raised can be reviewed. We appreciate the efforts of our Sydney team. We are sorry that your stay did not reflect the welcoming and well-run property we aim to provide. Thank you again for bringing these matters to our attention. We wish you all the best in your future travels.

reviews.positive_text: Location
reviews.negative_text:
Horrible experience checking in with Reyna and Sophia.

I messaged them at 11:00 in the morning to let them know that I wanted dinner. I also completed the online check-in, uploaded all my details, and was told I would receive a door code.

I arrived at the hotel at 7:00 pm and immediately emailed them and sent messages through Booking.com. Reyna ignored these messages until 7:42 pm.

When I finally spoke to her, I was given a series of different and contradictory explanations. First, I was told that none of my emails or Booking.com messages had been received. When I showed her evidence that they had been sent, the explanations changed.

I was then kept waiting for another 15 minutes while further explanations were given. I finally got through the door at around 8:00 pm.

I went to get the dinner I had requested earlier, only to find that there was no dinner available. I went back to reception to speak to Reyna, and again I was given a series of explanations that contradicted what I had previously been told.

I was left standing at reception with all my bags until approximately 8:20 pm. Reyna then gave me the wrong door code and refused to provide the contact details for her manager or supervisor.

By contrast, the gentleman who is normally on the screen on a Friday night has always been excellent and provides a completely different level of customer service.

My impression was that Reyna was worried about her handling of the situation being exposed, which is why I felt I was given different explanations, my questions weren't properly answered, and I was refused the manager's email address.

This was an absolutely horrible experience. The whole situation was unnecessarily stressful and time-consuming. Reyna's handling of the situation was extremely poor.
reviews.partner_reply:
We sincerely apologise for the difficulties you experienced during your arrival.

Thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback. We’re very sorry that your check-in experience was stressful and that you experienced delays and confusion regarding your access code.

We’d also like to clarify the dinner arrangement. While we appreciate that you contacted us earlier in the day regarding dinner, our complimentary dinner is served only during the designated dinner service period. As we do not reserve or hold individual portions, we’re unable to guarantee a meal for guests who arrive after the dinner service has ended. This is in place to help us manage food safely and fairly for all guests.

That said, we acknowledge that this should have been communicated clearly to you in advance, particularly after you had contacted us about dinner. We apologise for any misunderstanding or inconvenience this caused.

Regarding the check-in and door-code issues, we understand how frustrating it must have been to wait with your luggage and receive an incorrect code. We are reviewing the circumstances and communication with the team involved to ensure that guests receive clear and accurate information and prompt assistance when issues arise.

We appreciate your feedback and are sorry that your arrival did not reflect the level of service we aim to provide.

reviews.negative_text:
Since the beginning the communication was bad. Once we arrived we had a ridiculous check in by remote staff. Pictures they show on Booking are totally fake!!! Everything is so dirty, public toilets are cleaner! As we entered our room the small was so bad, like nobody opened the door or the windows for weeks. Not a chair or table to put your stuff, the wall and the mirror were terrible, there were hair on pillows and sheets. We decided to book another accommodation even we lost the money. But we came back for the free dinner as we paid for it: pictures show you a large and rich buffet but guess what? It was just a tomato pasta and a raw salad without even oil in it.
They provide luggage storage but in another hotel of the same brand (15 mins way), fortunately they did me a favor and we could have left there one of our backpack until 6 pm but the normal hour of the storage is until 12 pm. Does it make any sense if the check out is at 10 am?
Anyway, it’s a scam don’t go there, you can find better accommodation for the same price.

We also appreciate your comments regarding cleanliness, room facilities, dining, and luggage storage arrangements. Guest feedback is reviewed carefully as part of our ongoing efforts to improve the overall guest experience. Our complimentary dinner offering is intended as an added benefit for guests and may vary from day to day.

Regarding luggage storage, availability and operating hours may vary depending on the property and operational requirements. We always aim to assist guests where possible and appreciate your acknowledgment of the accommodation that was provided.

While we respectfully disagree with the characterization of the property as a "scam," we understand that every guest's expectations and experiences are different. We value all feedback and use it to continually review and improve our services.

Thank you again for sharing your perspective, and we wish you safe travels in the future. 😊🏡✨

reviews.positive_text: Комната нормальная в которой жил, вид на мост Харбор и Оперу Сиднея. Расположение хорошее
reviews.negative_text:
Начнем с заселения, приходит сообщение от отеля, что необходимо зарегистрироваться онлайн, но в сообщении нет никаких ссылок или QR кода для регистрации онлайн, я прилетел в Сидней и написал им в 1:30PM, с вопросом где регистрироваться онлайн, но ответа так и не поступило, хотя пишут что отвечают на сообщения в букинге и по почте своей, я решил ехать в отель. Приехал в отель в 3:00PM, на двери есть QR-код для регистрации, я зарегистрировался и перешел в приложение GOKI, но там сказано было что вы не зарегистрированы и соответственно нет никаких кодов для того, чтобы попасть в комнату и внутрь здания! В итоге я простоял на улице у двери в отель под дождем до практически 05:00PM, так как никто не отвечал на мои сообщения по почте, в букинге, в ватсап с 1:30PM! Ответили только ближе к 5 вечера, и пришлось ждать когда мне отправят коды от дверей! Причина в том, что якобы сотрудник не видел мои сообщения!!! В общем много времени потрачено впустую при онлайн заселении. 
По поводу хранения багажа, если вы привыкли оставлять в отеле, то это не ваш вариант, оставить можно только до полудня! И они могли бы пойти мне навстречу, с учетом того, что два часа я не мог попасть в свою комнату, но нет, мне отказали, можно только до полудня, а у меня вылет был вечером! Из-за проблем с регистрацией я не смог зарегистрироваться на ужин. По поводу чистоты, ну помойте вы уже окна в комнатах с «видом» на мост и оперу, там просто разглядеть надо все через эту грязь. В зоне кухни грязно, ремонт сделан приятный в светлых тонах, но везде грязь! Грязные раковины, зона готовки, в раковине еда, посуда не мытая! В общем сначала хотел забронировать еще на 6 ночей через неделю, но это того не стоит, поэтому передумал.

reviews.positive_text:
I had stayed at this property several times last year, and while the customer service wasn’t always outstanding, I understood it’s a hostel environment. However, during one stay, I was placed right next to a bathroom, and there was constant door slamming throughout the night (2–4am). Understandably, I was frustrated and contacted reception via the intercom. Unfortunately, I was told there were no options to move rooms and that I would just have to put up with it.
The following morning, the manager informed me that I was no longer welcome, despite having stayed there for nearly two months the previous year and across multiple locations. I found this response extreme and unjustified. When I tried to discuss the situation, the manager was combative, dismissive, and ultimately hung up on me, stating he didn’t care and that I was effectively evicted.
I also later received a note about a bottle of rosé wine, even though I was not drinking and have never done so on the premises, which added to the confusion.
I want to highlight that Lia, a staff member, consistently provided excellent customer service—professional, helpful, and respectful at all times.
Months later, when I returned to Sydney, I even apologized in an attempt to stay again, though I’m not sure why I felt the need to. My reservation was declined regardless.
Overall, the situation felt disproportionate and poorly handled. I was left confused, as the outcome didn’t seem to match the circumstances.

reviews.title: Muy buena ubicación y relación calidad-precio, con algunos detalles operativos
reviews.positive_text: La ubicación es excelente: está muy bien conectado y se puede llegar fácilmente desde el aeropuerto en metro, prácticamente sales de la estación y estás ahí. Las habitaciones son cómodas para ser un hostel, con buen ambiente y huéspedes respetuosos. Tiene buen WiFi, cocina equipada para guardar comida, varias duchas y baños disponibles, y servicios como lavandería que hacen la estancia práctica. En general, ofrece una muy buena relación calidad-precio considerando lo céntrico que es.
reviews.negative_text: El acceso con equipaje puede ser incómodo, ya que hay escaleras y las habitaciones están en el segundo o tercer piso, y esto podría comunicarse mejor en el anuncio para que los huéspedes estén más preparados. Tampoco es muy práctico el servicio de storage gratuito que ofrecen: tuve que caminar hasta otra propiedad de la misma cadena, lo que implicó una subir la cuestas de Surry Hills y es una caminata de unos 30 minutos, pero es más rápido si se hace en Uber. El sistema de recepción es remoto (pantallas con atención desde fuera del país), lo que puede hacer el check-in más lento o confuso. Además, las puertas con código a veces fallan, lo cual puede ser incómodo. Finalmente, al estar en una zona con vida nocturna, puede haber algo de ruido los fines de semana, y la limpieza es correcta pero no impecable.

Seguridad en el ingreso gracias al software Goki. Bastantes franceses y latinoamericanos, algunos son long-term, pero aún así muy sociables. Los baños eran limpiados diariamente, y al menos durante la mañana se veían muy bien debido a que han sido remodelados. La ubicación es excelente si te interesan las fiestas en la zona de Kings Cross (como La Cueva, una de las principales fiestas latinas de Sydney), muchos restaurantes cerca, y está a pocos metros de la estación de tren del mismo nombre que te lleva a la ciudad o a Bondi Junction (desde donde puedes tomar buses hacia Bondi Beach). Las literas son normales, ni duras ni muy cómodas.
reviews.negative_text: Roomies muy desordenados, dejaban todo tirado. A mi litera le faltaba la repisa para poner cosas que todas las demás sí tenían, y la luz personal estaba desconectada de la corriente (nunca hallé la toma correspondiente). Pocos baños para la cantidad de huéspedes, aunque esperable en una casa antigua reconvertida. La cena a menudo era carente de proteína, y la zanahoria en la ensalada era literalmente incomible por ser tan dura. Vi una cucaracha muerta en el comedor secundario y, al día siguiente, otra pequeña y mojada sobre la encimera. Muchos huecos sin tapar por donde otras cucarachas podrían colarse, aunque en fin, así es Sydney. El comedor principal al parecer se limpia semanalmente, porque siempre lo vi sucio. El camino a la lavandería está muy desordenado y luce bastante mal.

A girl living there said there had not been paper there for a while, which is crazy given that they said they had cleaners walking around the property. 
Lastly after the checkout they could only hold the bags until 12… Yea pretty gross. 
Had to shower myself twice before feeling clean after this visit…

reviews.title: Not as advertised and poorly maintained.
reviews.negative_text:
Unfortunately, this hostel does not match the photos or description shown on Booking. The exterior and interior look significantly different from what is advertised, and the overall condition of the property is far below expectations.
There is also inconsistent information provided to guests. The document sent at check-in states that check-in is at 2:00pm, yet staff strictly enforce a 3:00pm check-in and explained that the document is “outdated.” If policies have changed, official documents provided to guests should be updated accordingly to avoid confusion.
Check-in is restricted due to “cleaning,” however, upon arrival, the room was clearly not properly cleaned. Floors were not vacuumed, trash was left behind, and during my three-night stay, the room was never cleaned. The document also states that bed sheets are changed daily unless requested otherwise and that rooms are cleaned every day. Neither of these services were provided.
On my last day, after previous guests checked out, I pointed out leftover trash to the cleaning staff. When I returned later that evening, the trash was still there. The only action taken was placing a new garbage bag.
There is only one bathroom per floor for approximately four or five rooms, resulting in constant queues. The bathroom was noisy, poorly maintained, and lacked basic amenities. Towels are not provided and cost $10 to rent, which is significantly higher than typical hostel rates.
Breakfast and dinner are advertised as included, but both are offered only within a very limited one-hour window, which is impractical given the number of guests. Dinner was extremely basic, with no beverages included. When water was requested, only tap water was offered. Considering the overall hygiene standards of the property, this was concerning.
There is no physical reception — communication is via a remote screen, and assistance was limited and inconsistent.

reviews.positive_text: The location was good, not far from the cbd
reviews.negative_text: I don’t usually write a reviews but this place deserves one. The staff are like robots, not helpful at all. They just repeat the same sentences all the time. I arrived at 10am, they canceled my flight and it took me whole night and 3 flights to get to Sydney. I slept 1 hour. I asked the receptionist if it’s possible to check in earlier and even was ready to pay for it. She said no. I asked if she could at least ask housekeeper to do my bed first, she didn’t want to help me at all. She said the check in time is 3pm. I asked at 2:45 if my room is ready and she said that the bed is ready but the room is not cleaned yet and I have to wait till 3pm. The room at 3pm was completely dirty. She was clearly lying to me all the time and the bed was done long before. There was trash on the floor and hairs in the sink. It was disgusting. The other bathroom in the hostel was also very dirty. The receptionist works online and have no idea what the housekeepers are doing, or not doing and she is not willing to help guests at all. I saw her asking someone is that person works there, how she can not know that? Also the day I was checking out, the other receptionist told me I can store my backpack till 2pm and when I asked if I can pick it up at 3pm she just repeated the same sentence. Didn’t even say that sorry it’s not possible or anything, just was repeating the same sentence as a robot. Like why I can store my backpack only till 2pm? The hostel costs 75$ a night, I should be about to at least leave my bag there when I wait for my flight. It’s ridiculous. Also to rent a towel is $15. You can definitely find a better place in this price with nice and helpful staff. There are many different hostels on this street.

reviews.title: Que sea barato no implica que su mantenimiento sea deficiente.
reviews.positive_text:
Si estás valorando este hostel en tu estancia en Sydney posiblemente será por su ubicación y porque es de los que incluye desayuno y cena en el precio.

Posiblemente ambos puntos son sus claras ventajas para decidirse frente a otros, aunque con matices.

Respecto a la ubicación, personalmente creo que es su punto fuerte. Bien conectado a la estación central de tren, está en un punto que andando puedes llegar a Circular Quay en apenas 30-40 minutos andando a un ritmo normal. Estás en un punto que si te decides por ir a The Rocks, o a la zona de Chinatown, también está a menos de 30 minutos andando, por lo que estás prácticamente en el centro de todo.
Si además planeas acercarte a Bondi Beach desde aquí, hay línea de autobús y en menos de 1h de trayecto estás allí con un solo transbordo.

Otro de sus puntos positivos, en mi caso debo destacar las habitaciones. Literas rígidas y cómodas que no se mueven en absoluto (si has ido a otros hostel sabes de lo que hablo). Colchones decentes por el precio a pagar y habitación relativamente correcta en cuanto a espacio (al menos en las habitaciones de 6 personas).

Por último, la parte del desayuno y cena que incluyen en el precio. Desde luego que es una ventaja frente a otras opciones de hostel que no incluyen nada. Desayuno básico que se sirve de 7:30am a 9am, incluye zumo, leche, té/café, cereales y pan de molde con diferentes mermeladas, mantequilla y crema de cacahuete. Eso es todo. Simple y básico. Y lo mismo ocurre en la cena. Horario de 18:30pm a 19:45pm, suelen ser platos básicos donde no podemos destacar que sean las mejores opciones nutritivamente hablando. Pasta algunos días, pollo con puré de patata otros, o arroz con carne picada. No esperes la mejor cena posible, de hecho da más sensación de comedor social que de hostel.
reviews.negative_text:
Soy crítico porque en mis últimos 5 meses viajando he estado en muchos hostel y entiendo que si busco las opciones más económicas, renuncio a ciertas comodidades que otros más caros si me ofrecen (como más cantidad de baños, cocinas más grandes y más equipadas, zonas comunes de mejor calidad y más amplias, etc).

Lo que no está bien es la falta de mantenimiento general del lugar. Es un hostel viejo si nos centramos en sus comodidades, y salvo las habitaciones que a mi parecer estaban en buen estado general, el resto fue bastante decepcionante.

La mayoría de baños estaban viejos y no funcionaban como deberían. Ya sea un grifo roto, una ducha sin mucha presión de agua u otro con el suelo siempre con agua. Se notaba una falta de mantenimiento del lugar. Por no decir que en general estaban sucios. Paredes de las duchas por ejemplo que dudo se hayan limpiado en los últimos meses, papeleras llenas muchas ocasiones, y en definitiva, sensación de abandono.

Por supuesto, entiendo que pagar un precio reducido por una noche en Sydney con desayuno y cena incluido, tienes que renunciar a cierto confort en tu estancia. Pero eso no implica llegar a un lugar con poco mantenimiento y con zonas sucias en general.

Rotten place. I would never go back, I’d rather sleep in the subway. I paid way too much because they lie in their ads, while there are so many better, cheaper hostels with friendly, attentive staff. reviews.title: Terrible experience, not as advertised
reviews.positive_text: Look, honestly, I booked this place thinking it was a pod. It's not. This was the cheapest option.
reviews.negative_text: Okay, honestly, this place was very expensive for what it was. The 'security' was a code to open the doors from the street. No receptionist (she was working remotely). No staff on site. The rooms were terrible - be warned, this place is just a hostel with a basic bunk bed layout, there is a security code to get into your room. The 'privacy' is a basic privacy curtain (black) which offers no security. I was very nervous as I booked thinking it was a Pod in Circular Quay but it isn't. When I asked for a bed lower to the floor, the 'support staff' told me to use a specific bed, which was already being occupied. Waited a very long time for a response and a resolution to my issue. I had a look at the toilets and was disgusted. I decided not to shower or use the bathroom while I was there. Will not be staying there again

reviews.positive_text: Beds are great.My 6 beds room was big. However the floor shakes when someone walks around but definitely the most comfortable bed I've slept on in a hostel
reviews.negative_text:
The kitchen is full of fruit flies, the bathrooms are constantly wet, (but pressure and water temperature are good) kitchenware is poorly washed and the place is older and beaten up compared to what is shown on booking. Only 1 bathroom per floor in my building and some nights I had to go in the building next door (part of the hostel) to use the toilet. At checkout, I was out of the room early, but I had a few trips up and down the stairs to take my suitcase and backpacks and they changed the code to gate and room and it was a struggle to get my stuff. Just give a 20 minutes window?! We are leaving, Jezzzz. Food seems to be like a little buffet from the pictures but it isn't. I do not recommend it if you have allergies, it doesn't seem like the place who would be able to respect cross contamination and so on. Also with the condition of the kitchen, I didn't feel like eating there either. Bring some good earplugs cause the AC will scream if turned on.
There's no in person receptionist, just remotely through the screen. 

If you're on a budget, it's fine, it's also close to the metro and it's easy to get there from the airport.

Les chambres ne sont pas nettoyées (déchets sous le lit à mon arrivée, qui étaient toujours là à mon départ, quasiment une semaine après !). Quasiment tous les lavabos sont bouchés, donc l’eau sale reste stagner.  Il n’y a pas d’aération dans les douches, donc en plus de la chaleur étouffante qui y règne, l’eau de condensation ruisselle sur les murs et tombe du plafond. La cuisine, qui n’en est pas une, laisse plus qu’à désirer ! Pas assez de place dans les frigos et les placards, aliments moisis, 2 (deux !!) plaques de cuisson amovibles (plaque n’ayant qu’un seul feu) pour toute l’auberge !! 
Pas d’ascenseur, donc si vous êtes au premier ou au deuxième étage, bon courage pour monter vos bagages et pour les marches plusieurs fois par jours !

Kind regards,

Nur der Essraum als Gemeinschaftsraum, Frühstück spärlich. Das Dinner war allerdings gut, die Lage ist auch gut. Überall hängen Hinweisschilder, dass videoüberwacht wird und die Höhe der verhängten Bußgelder, wenn man die Hausordnung nicht einhält. Auch noch nicht erlebt habe ich das strikte Verbot von Alkohol. 
Es gibt kein Personal vor Ort, die Rezeption ist ein Tablet. Der Checkin war holperig und hat bei mir online nicht wirklich funktioniert. 
Nach dem Aufenthalt ist es nicht möglich sein Gepäck dort für ein paar Stunden in einem Storrage zu lassen. Nur auf eigenes Risiko im Essraum, einen Gepäckraum gibt es nicht. 
Nicht empfehlenswert.

Sehr enttäuschender Aufenthalt

Unser Aufenthalt in diesem Hostel war leider sehr enttäuschend. Auf den Bildern wirkte alles sehr gepflegt, relativ neu und durch die angeblichen 4 Sterne auch durchaus ansprechend. Vor Ort bot sich jedoch ein komplett anderes Bild.

Bereits beim Betreten des Eingangs fiel ein sehr unangenehmer Geruch auf, der stark an einen nassen Hund erinnerte. Das gesamte Gebäude sowie die Zimmer machten einen stark heruntergekommenen Eindruck. Der Aufenthalts- bzw. Speiseraum war ungepflegt und überhaupt nicht einladend, um dort seine Mahlzeiten einzunehmen. Tische und Wände waren sichtbar dreckig.

Die Toiletten erinnerten eher an öffentliche WCs am Hauptbahnhof – so unappetitlich, dass man sich regelrecht davor ekelte, dort zu duschen. Auch die Vorhänge und Betten waren befleckt und schmutzig.

Nach Rücksprache mit dem Hostelpersonal wurde uns mitgeteilt, dass Reinigungsmittel zur Verfügung stehen. Ganz ehrlich: Es ist zwar ein Hostel und man erwartet keinen Luxus, aber zu verlangen, dass Gäste selbst den Dreck anderer beseitigen, weil das Housekeeping nicht hinterherkommt, ist schlichtweg frech.

Alles in allem kann ich nur sagen: Verlasst euch nicht auf die positiven Bewertungen dieses Hostels – sie spiegeln die Realität absolut nicht wider.

While we do not offer hotel-level luxury, we maintain daily cleaning schedules for all shared spaces and bedrooms, and our housekeeping team follows strict hygiene and inspection procedures.

Regarding cleaning supplies, these are made available as an optional convenience for guests who wish to tidy personal or shared spaces during peak periods, which is common practice in many hostels. This does not replace our housekeeping service.

We also note that our accommodation continues to receive consistent positive feedback from a large number of guests who value the location, affordability, and social atmosphere we provide. That said, we understand that hostel-style accommodation may not be suitable for everyone, particularly those expecting private-hotel standards.

We appreciate all feedback and will continue monitoring our facilities closely to ensure standards are maintained. We wish you all the best in your future travels.

I had to repeat like 6 times that I want AC off, the guy just didn't seem to understand what I say. Took away working remote but left a faulty one anyway. I didn't understand what it was, completely. reviews.title: Das Hostel an sich ist sehr sozial, ich persönlich habe mich aber im gesamten Umfeld nicht wohlgefühlt.
reviews.positive_text:
An sich war das Bett sauber und bequem. Auch das Zimmer war groß, sodass es kein Problem war sich das Zimmer mit 5 weiteren Personen zu teilen. 
Das gemeinsame Frühstück & Abendessen hat dafür gesorgt, dass man immer wieder mit den Leuten in Kontakt kam, somit hinterließ das Hostel für mich einen eigentlich sehr sozialen Eindruck. Außerdem konnte man durch das Essen, was in Ordnung war, echt etwas Geld sparen - also gerade für Low-Budget Traveller eine gute Sache!
reviews.negative_text: Leider erweckte das Hostel auf mich den Eindruck, als würde man sich nicht so wirklich drum kümmern. Viele Küchenschränke, Schlösser, Türklinken… waren kaputt und teils war es leider (bis auf das Bett) auch nicht sehr sauber. Gerade die Küche war eher etwas chaotisch. Zudem wirkt auch der Außenbereich nicht so gepflegt und definitiv nicht so wie auf den Bildern. Vor dem Hostel haben sich teilweise sehr suspekte Menschen versammelt, wodurch ich mich selbst, gerade abends, einfach nicht so wohl gefühlt habe. Oftmals hat unser Zimmer abends deshalb auch sehr nach Gras gerochen, da diese Leute eben vor der Tür gekifft haben - für mich persönlich nicht so angenehm und hat nicht dafür gesorgt, dass ich mich wohl gefühlt habe.

reviews.title: HORRÍVEL
reviews.positive_text: Não gostei de absolutamente nada.
reviews.negative_text:
O hostel é IMUNDO, bagunçado e feio. Quando você entra no hostel tem um corredorzinho apertado e lotado de malas e não existe ninguem para te recepcionar. A "recepcionista" é uma mini televisão onde fica uma atendente remota, das Filipinas, para fazer seu check in. Não tem ninguem na gerência do hostel para te atender. Entrando para a cozinha e área comum, a coisa piora MUITO. Tudo muito, muito sujo e bagunçado, A cozinha um caos e as geladeiras tão lotadas que era impossível sequer guardar uma água lá dentro.
Fiquei em dois quartos pois a primeira noite dividi com amigos. O primeiro quarto estava congelando e não tinha como aumentar o ar, muito menos reclamar com alguém do hostel fantasma. O banheiro era externo, dividido com todo o andar e estava um completo NOJO. IMUNDO, não tenho nem palavras para descrever aquele chiqueiro.
O segundo quarto era apenas feminino, ficava no que parecia um anexo ao predio principal e sempre que alguem andava pelo quarto, minha cama tremia pois o chao não tem boa sustentação. O banheiro estava sujo também, mas um pouco menos do que o banheiro externo e o quarto tinha cheiro de mofo.
Essa foi a PIOR experiência que tive em um hostel na minha vida. 
Não gosto de fazer avaliações negativas pois não quero prejudicar ninguém, mas também não posso deixar outras pessoas serem enganadas como fui.
Não acredite nas fotos, a realidade é bem diferente e para esse hostel ser considerado RUIM, ainda precisa melhorar muito!

Der uns mitgeteilte Code für die Zimmertür funktionierte nicht, auch der zweite Code ermöglichte keinen Zugang zum Zimmer. Ein weiterer Gast, welchen ich um Hilfe bat, sagte aus, dass auch sein Zimmercode nicht funktioniere und er deshalb ständig einen Schuh in die Zimmertür stellen musste, damit ihm der Eintritt jederzeit möglich war. Zudem wurden wir um 21.30 Uhr von einem Angestellten aufgefordert, die Zimmertür zu öffnen, denn er wollte an der Decke einen Rauchmelder installieren. Er erklärte es sei ein Notfall, wir hörten die Bohrmaschine aus den Nebenzimmern. Erst nach mehrmaligem intensiven Verneinen unsererseits entfernte sich der Angestellte und ließ uns schlussendlich in Ruhe.
Das Zimmer war extrem klein (2x3m)und man konnte sich kaum umdrehen, da die Koffer auf dem Boden ausgepackt werden mussten.
Der Preis war meiner Meinung nicht gerechtfertigt, es fehlte auch die Sauberkeit und ein einfacher angemessener Komfort.

reviews.title: Nice hostel, but poor food, and no on-site staff.
reviews.positive_text:
Positives : 
- 3 mins walk to Kings Cross station
- cooking facilities available.
- laundry was $4AUD for wash and the same for the drier.
reviews.negative_text:
Negatives :
- no staff on site - all comms are online, or via a video call on a monitor at the entrance
- dinner is awful. Truly bad. We got mash and an under-cooked chicken one night. I had to buy a curry from a Thai restaurant opposite, cos I couldn't risk eating the chicken.
- Breakfast is very basic. Cereals, toast and jam. It's meant to be served at 7:30am, but one day it didn't become available till 7:50 - an issue for me cos I had to rush to the airport to catch my flight.
- The comms keep saying that dinner is from 6:30pm onwards, but it's NOT. It's not available until 7:30pm. This inconvenienced myself and two other guests, as we had all come back to the hostel for 6:30pm to be fed. A simple change in the Wattsapp message is not much effort for the hotel management to make. 
- there are cameras everywhere and signs everywhere saying "Smoking.....alcohol....$500 fine", "Not cleaning your dishes....$100 fine" etc etc. You feel like a person in a Big Brother House being watched at all times.


Tip : stay in the Harbour View room - it's facing away from the street so you won't hear any noise.

reviews.positive_text:
The location is excellent—just a few minutes’ walk from Kings Cross Station, and within walking distance to the Royal Botanic Gardens, the Art Gallery of NSW, the State Library, and even the Sydney Opera House, all under 30 minutes away.

The included dinner is a nice bonus and much appreciated. However, during my 6-night stay, the menu was quite repetitive (two nights of pasta and four nights of biryani). A bit more variety would definitely improve the experience.

The area feels safe, and the location alone makes this place a convenient base for exploring Sydney. With a few adjustments, especially around dining options and room amenities, this could be an even better stay.
reviews.negative_text:
The hostel does not have a lift, and the hallways are very narrow, which makes moving around with luggage a bit difficult. The shower/toilet and common areas also feel quite cramped. At night, when the kitchen is closed, the only available common space is very small, so it may not be ideal for those who need to do remote work while traveling.

Another small inconvenience is that there are no hooks in the rooms for towels or other items.

Não tem placa identificando o local. O atendimento é virtual. Uma moça te atende por vídeo. Péssimo atendimento, por sinal. Fui com minha mãe e colocaram a gente em um quarto misto onde um casal habitava há meses, as coisas deles todas espalhadas pelo chão. Isso porque eu especificamente havia requerido um quarto exclusivo para mulheres para minha mãe. Não conseguiram e nem resolveram esse problema. 

O banheiro estava frequentemente sujo e está precisando de reforma. Em uma das noites, um grupo de hóspedes começou a gritar e cantar no quarto ao lado, estilo karaoke. Durou uma hora. E não havia ninguém no hostel para fazer alguma coisa a respeito. Foi a minha pior experiência em hostels na minha vida. Piora: acompanhado pela minha mãe aventureira pela primeira vez. 

Não acreditem nas fotos bem produzidas. Elas também me enganaram. A vista que prometem da ponte, é por uma janela ao lado da pia do lavabo do quarto. Uma piada. 

Enfim... é sujo, lotado, barulhento e mal organizado.

reviews.title: Great experience at Azzurro
reviews.positive_text:
I loved staying at Azzurro. The location is one of the best in the whole city, it has a beautiful view of the Opera House and it's close to a lot of useful establishments for students and backpackers, such as the Kings Cross library, the Kings Cross train station, supermarkets, grocery stores, washing house, pubs, restaurants and more.

The hostel fulfills the proposal of being a non party hostel. Despite that, this is the perfect place to be surrounded by people from several countries and it's very easy to make friends, people are very kind and friendly.

The beds are very comfortable, mostly because of the bedding set and the curtains they have in it.

The staff is great, they are friendly and whatever you need they will help.
reviews.negative_text:
The common areas are not very clean, especially the tables, and there's not much space to put your supermarket things in the storerooms or in the fridges, so try not to buy a lot of things!!!

The hostel is not responsible for your belongings, so keep a careful eye to your belongings, mostly small things, for example, jewelery or your umbrella, because people will steal it. I'm not saying this is a characteristic of this hostel. It could happen anywhere, but be careful. 

The food could be better and have more meal variations, but, at least, they are very generous about it, so it's impossible to starve.

reviews.room_type: Mixed Pod Twin with Ensuite Bathroom
reviews.title: I went to the room and left
reviews.positive_text: I don't have any positive feedback. I found the info on the page confusing and the experience frustrating
reviews.negative_text: I turned up to the room and I thought I had booked a room with 2 bunk beds and a private bathroom. It said twin so I thought I had booked for the 2 people even though I was traveling on my own. I wanted to book the room for myself and was happy to pay for both. The price looked to be double the single person rate. But someone else, a stranger, was already sleeping in the bottom bunk when I arrived. I have back issues so the top bunk was not very easy for me and I had thought I would be able to use the bottom bunk when I made the booking. I recently did a similar thing at another place in Bondi. It was only 9pm and the other person already had their stuff literally all over the place, in the room, the kitchenette and the bathroom, and they were already asleep in the bottom bunk. They also had the aircon blaring on some hot setting so the room was like an oven. I tried to message the chat as there was no staff there that I could find and they took ages to reply. I asked if there was another room I could change to and they said no they were already booked. I asked for a locker I could use to put my personal things in with a lock. They finally replied and said there was a locker but you have to bring your own lock. Which I didn't have with me... and I did not see info about this on the pages or messages/emails. It was very heavy rain outside so I sat in the kitchen for a bit to try and figure out what to do.. I decided to book a room at another hotel near by which was expensive but I needed to be able to sleep for the next day of work and not have to sleep in some kind of sauna with a stranger and no security for my belongings. I don't usually leave negative reviews but I was really put out with this experience. They did try to apologise on the chat and offer me a different private room for another night with a small discount but I was only staying one night in Sydney for work. Much clearer info on the page would have helped.

reviews.positive_text: The people I met were lovely and was sad to end my stay early for that.
reviews.negative_text:
Honestly, I never thought I'd write a bad review but I'm quite disappointed at this point. I was given a room in the basement which was fine but it was quite stuffy and it smelt very damp. They gave me a new room but I had to pay an upgrade. The new room was a bit better but still smelt. There wasn't any staff, just a virtual receptionist which is fine but makes it a little harder to speak to someone. Most people there seem to be inbetween jobs/working which is also fine but not the vibe I was looking for (everyone I met was lovely though). By this point I was tempted to leave. 
The last thing that made me leave was when I pulled the curtain in my bed to get out, it fell and hit my face. It hurt! I spoke to them over WhatsApp and they were very apologetic. However, no one got back to me about a resolution and to be honest I never expect a refund or anything but was quite fed up by this point and just disappointed no one got back to me even after reminding them. I hate writing bad reviews and understand hostels are hostels but I do expect the basics to be decent at least. I waited a while before writing this but I needed to be honest.

reviews.title: No pods. Not a hotel. Fire hazard
reviews.positive_text:
Calls itself a pod hotel.  It's not. 

No pods.
Not a hotel.

It's a typical run down basic dorm for people who are staying long-term.  Really shouldn't be listed on Booking. And maybe should be shut down due to UNSAFE electrical connections.  

**********
LOCATION
+5 minutes from Kings Crossing metro

ROOM
+Has a privacy curtain
+Has a shelf

BATHROOM
+Hot water
+Clean

STAFF
+kitchen staff was working hard to feed so many people

KITCHEN/MEALS 
+The dinner was decent. Big plate of pasta with side salad one day. Rice with some tofu or something the second. 

+Breakfast was a bowl of cereal, toast with jam, butter, peanut butter or chocolate and juice amidst the chaos of dozens of people trying to get theirs before it runs out. 

NOISE 
+Mostly quiet

OTHER
+Codes instead of keys is one fewer thing to have to carry around
reviews.negative_text:
Calls itself a pod hotel.  It's not. 

No pods.
Not a hotel.

It's a typical run down basic dorm for people who are staying long-term.  Really shouldn't be listed on Booking. And maybe should be shut down due to UNSAFE electrical connections.  

ROOM
--UNSAFE outlet situation.  An extension cord wrapped around the bed railing plugged into a power strip that lies directly on the mattress.  Total FIRE HAZARD. 

**I'll try to provide a photo, but booking rarely uploads the photos, so I'll post it on Google maps as well.

*****HERE'S THE LINK to the photos*****
https://goo.gl/maps/dGFqVMX8vLaT7XVb6?g_st=ac

-bunk beds (NOT PODS) are old. Lumpy mattress and pillow. 

-the shelf is nowhere near the outlet (a rigged extension cord) so my phone couldn't be on the shelf while charging at night. Which defeats the purpose of the shelf. 

STAFF/LOBBY
-Ridiculous online check-in. Gets rid of a paying job and is worse for the customer.  

KITCHEN/MEALS 
-Multiple messages stating to register for dinner by 4PM. No message indicates HOW to register for the dinner. When you fill out the registration for the room, there's in option to register for dinner including all dinners during your stay, but, unclear if that actually works.  I had to show the WhatsApp message saying they would tell the chef I had registered to get the dinner.  

-one table with about 6 chairs for dozens of people trying to eat

-no water refill

WIFI
-WiFi listed in the check-in messages has no connection.  There are other networks that MIGHT be legit. But, who knows. The hostel should update their messages and not just reply that the comments help them improve.  Go ahead and improve by providing the correct information and not providing incorrect information.

reviews.positive_text: Le positif : Les matelas sont confortables, les douches et toilettes sont propres, et l’équipe est réactive sur WhatsApp. Le petit-déjeuner est très basique mais correct.
reviews.negative_text:
Nous avons séjourné dans une chambre double privée pendant plusieurs nuits et avons été très déçus.

🔒 Sécurité : De la nourriture a été volée directement dans notre chambre pendant notre absence. Il n’y a que le personnel de ménage qui avait le code de la porte. Aucune solution ni compensation proposée. C’est inadmissible.

 Repas inclus : Nous avons mangé la même chose tous les soirs pendant 6 jours : pâtes à la tomate et riz au curry avec un peu de poulet. Pour le prix, on aurait pu faire nos courses, manger plus varié et pour moins cher.

 Confort de la chambre : Pas de vraies fenêtres fermées, seulement des dalles pivotantes en verre, donc bruit constant. Le store restait fermé car la fenêtre donnait directement sur un passage. Il y avait aussi un trou pour la ventilation, ce qui n’aide pas au calme.

 Nuisances sonores : L’insonorisation est inexistante. On entend tout : les gens dans les escaliers extérieurs (Butlers Stairs), les discussions, les joints fumés juste en bas de la fenêtre, comme s’ils étaient dans la chambre. Impossible de dormir sans bouchons d’oreilles.

Cuisine commune : Une seule plaque, pas assez de vaisselle (manque de mugs notamment), et peu de respect des règles (vaisselle sale non rangée, etc.). Et on y était en basse saison.

En résumé : Le rapport qualité-prix est très mauvais. Pour le même prix (voire moins cher), on aurait eu bien mieux dans un petit appartement avec cuisine. Nous ne recommandons pas du tout cet établissement.

The first impression was terrible!!
I recommend you check the Google photos.
We had booked a private room for two, and it was located in the basement. When we entered, we were both speechless—it didn’t look anything like the pictures. It gave us prison vibes and was in desperate need of renovation. It wasn’t clean, it wasn’t bright, and it was freezing cold with no heating.

Luckily, we were able to switch rooms and were moved to a four-bed dorm. That was better, but the first thing we saw was a dead cockroach, and there were stains everywhere. We were really disappointed by how carelessly and falsely the place had been presented.

Breakfast wasn’t good, but at least the dinner was.

reviews.title: Budget option for warmer days
reviews.positive_text:
The included breakfast and optional dinner are definitely highlights – breakfast is simple but sufficient, and the pre-order dinner is a convenient way to ensure a proper meal. The dinner I had was actually very good, and it’s a great benefit to have this option directly at the hostel.

The location is a plus – like most hostels around King’s Cross, there’s a terrace with a nice view of the Harbour Bridge.
That said, the overall experience might be more pleasant in warmer seasons.
reviews.negative_text:
However, one evening I asked for seconds, and the main cook told us to come back in 20 minutes. I waited over 30 minutes, and each time I approached, he just said “wait, wait” and served others instead. Eventually, there was nothing left, and I had to go out and buy food elsewhere – which felt like a big minus.

The room I stayed in was in the basement, quite cold and not very well insulated. I can’t imagine staying there during winter. The room was spacious, but everything creaked, and there was no power outlet for the upper bunk.
Also, the place felt dimly lit, which made it hard to find at first. The hostel operates in two separate buildings, but it’s not clear where you’re staying. After booking on Booking.com, you still need to register on the hostel’s website and then check in again at reception – which is unnecessarily complicated.

There is no larger lounge area in the accommodation where you can work or relax. Only an extended version of the dining room, which was always dirty, at least during my stay.

Overall, a fair option for travelers on a budget – especially during warmer days – but be prepared for some practical discomforts.

It was impossible to sleep! When I complained the management was totally uncooperative and unfriendly. Don't stay there! There are several nice hostels in Sydney.

reviews.positive_text: Worst place I’ve stayed in Oz by far. Ratings must be from bots, check Google reviews and they’re really low. Photos misleading. After traveling for 3 days I arrive to a room that was really smelly, that deep feet and smelly socks smell, looks like it hasn’t been cleaned or freshened up for days, there’s peoples belongings literally all over the place and I don’t even have enough space to open my luggage, a small surf bag, the place is so tiny, literally so small. The aircon was right beside my bed by my head and it was full of dust and dirt, pumping air right into my nostrils. Disgusting. Furniture old and worn out.
reviews.negative_text: People living there treating it like their own bedroom and the staff (staff, what staff!?) do nothing about it. “Thanks for your patience” is all they had to say to me via text. Woke up to a guest asking for his mattress to be changed because he had been itchy for a few days and full of bites, potentially bed bugs. 24h later and the management was still unaware as I had contacted them again to express my discontent. Had to deep clean all my clothes and belongings upon departure. Also, there’s signs everywhere saying you’ll get a fine of you break any rules. Everywhere, it’s so unwelcoming. $100 dollar fine for not doing the dishes? My god is that ridiculous. No alcohol allowed on premises so no glass of wine over dinner, bizarre. Breakfast is peanut butter and jam and they ran out of jam. Usually not a big deal but c’mon. No plant based milk alternative. No staff to be seen in sight, the breakfast person/morning cleaner young kid, really kind but shy and avoids eye contact. Who is responsible for this place?? Any enquiry via text is answering by AI. Absolutely terrible experience. Avoid at all costs.

reviews.title: Unhygienic
reviews.positive_text:
This bathroom is an absolute disgrace. It looks like it hasn’t seen a proper clean or maintenance check in years. The tiles are stained and moldy, the floor is constantly wet and filthy, and the overall hygiene is frankly unacceptable. The shower area is particularly grim. There’s mold in the corners, grime in the grout, and a general stench of neglect.

The most ridiculous part? The “window.” There is no window. Just a wide open hole in the wall with rusted bars and a pathetic sign that says “Do not close the window.” Close what, exactly? The glass is completely gone. It is just an open gap to a dirty wall outside, with zero privacy and zero protection.

To make matters worse, I checked out four days early and received no compensation, refund, or even acknowledgment. I left the property well before my original check-out date, and despite following all proper procedures, no one offered any kind of reimbursement or explanation.

This isn’t just run-down. It shows a complete lack of care. It is one of those places you walk into and instantly regret. Avoid it if you have any choice.
reviews.negative_text: Avoid at all costs
reviews.partner_reply:
Hi Jonathan, Thank you for sharing your experience.

We understand that shared accommodations are not for everyone, and expectations can vary greatly. The bathroom in question is part of a budget-friendly shared facility, and while it may not meet the standards of a private hotel suite, it is regularly cleaned and maintained by our housekeeping and maintenance teams.

The window setup, as described in your review, is an intentional design feature for ventilation in a shared bathroom space. However, we understand that it may not suit everyone’s preference. Guests are always encouraged to raise any concerns during their stay so we can respond promptly.

We recognize your feedback and will continue to evaluate areas for improvement where appropriate.

Safe travels.

reviews.negative_text:
Vorsicht vor diesem Hostel – entspricht in keiner Weise den Standards von Booking.com

Ich bin wirklich enttäuscht von meinem Aufenthalt in diesem Hostel und kann es niemandem empfehlen. Bereits bei der Ankunft war der Eindruck negativ – auf dem Boden liefen Kakerlaken, was auf mangelnde Hygiene und unzureichende Reinigung hinweist.

Es gibt kein „Aufbewahrungsraum“ für Gepäck

Das Essen ist nicht genießbar: jeden Tag dasselbe, und zu allem Überfluss war das servierte Hühnchen teilweise roh. Das ist nicht nur unappetitlich, sondern auch gesundheitsschädlich.

Die Online-Bewertungen, die ich vor der Buchung gelesen habe, scheinen offensichtlich manipuliert oder gekauft zu sein – sie spiegeln in keiner Weise die Realität wider.

Die Gemeinschaftsbereiche sind unzureichend: Es gibt nur einen einzigen überfüllten „Community Room“, der für die Anzahl der Gäste viel zu klein ist. Auch die Sanitäranlagen sind ein Problem – es gibt viel zu wenige Badezimmer, und man steht morgens ewig in der Schlange.

Ich fordere Booking.com dringend auf, dieses Hostel zu überprüfen. Es entspricht in keiner Weise den auf der Plattform versprochenen Standards. Am besten wäre es, dieses Objekt aus dem Angebot zu entfernen. Es geht hier nicht nur um Komfort, sondern auch um Sicherheit und Gesundheit der Gäste
